result.rationale: The migration does `execute "INSERT INTO embeddable_hosts (host, ...) VALUES ('#{h}', ...)"` with raw string interpolation and no quoting, so a stored host value containing an apostrophe (or other SQL metacharacters) would break the INSERT during migration. This is a verifiable defect in the diff.
